import subprocess,json,time,base64,hmac,hashlib,urllib.request
try:
 data=json.loads(subprocess.run(['docker','inspect','academy-data-api'],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout)
 env=dict(x.split('=',1) for x in data[0]['Config']['Env'] if '=' in x)
 secret=env['PGRST_JWT_SECRET'];now=int(time.time());b64=lambda x:base64.urlsafe_b64encode(x).decode().rstrip('=')
 signed=b64(json.dumps({'alg':'HS256','typ':'JWT'}).encode())+'.'+b64(json.dumps({'aud':'academy-data-api','role':'academy_runtime','iat':now,'exp':now+30}).encode())
 token=signed+'.'+b64(hmac.new(secret.encode(),signed.encode(),hashlib.sha256).digest())
 req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:50600/users?select=service_activation(status)&limit=1',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Accept-Profile':'academy'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as response:
  rows=json.load(response);a=rows[0].get('service_activation') if rows else None
  print(json.dumps({'httpStatus':response.status,'rows':len(rows),'activationShape':'array' if isinstance(a,list) else 'object' if isinstance(a,dict) else 'null','activationStatus':a.get('status') if isinstance(a,dict) else None,'secretsPrinted':False,'queryProjection':'service_activation(status) only; one row; no identifiers/email'}))
except Exception:
 print(json.dumps({'probe':'FAILED','detailSuppressed':True}));raise SystemExit(1)
